Bill.BriefDescription: Expanding the statewide first responder building mapping information system to higher education facilities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to expanding the statewide first responder buildingmapping information system to higher education facilities; adding a newsection to chapter 36.28A RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 36.28A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The Washington association of sheriffs and police chiefs shallmap all of the state's community colleges as provided in RCW28B.50.040, and place the data into the statewide first responderbuilding mapping information system as provided in RCW 36.28A.060. Incompleting the mapping, the Washington association of sheriffs andpolice chiefs shall coordinate with the Washington state board forcommunity and technical colleges. (2) In consultation with the council of presidents, the Washingtonassociation of sheriffs and police chiefs shall study the addition offouryear institutions of higher education as defined in RCW 28B.10.016to the statewide first responder building mapping information system asprovided under RCW 36.28A.060. The study shall: p. 1 HB 2507 (a) Determine the costs of adding the fouryear institutions to themapping system; (b) Estimate the timelines to complete the project; and (c) Evaluate the potential risks associated with each building onall campuses and make a priority ordering recommendations as to whichbuildings should be mapped first, if resources are not available to mapall of the buildings. (3) The Washington association of sheriffs and police chiefs shallsubmit a report to the governor and the legislature by October 1, 2008.
If specific funding for the purposes of thisact, referencing this act by bill or chapter number, is not provided byJune 30, 2008, in the omnibus appropriations act, this act is null andvoid.
